epics.title: Payment Gateway Integration
epics.description: Integration with a payment gateway (Stripe) for credit card payments, subscription management, and payment event handling

stories.title: As a customer, I want to make credit card payments, so that I can purchase products and services
stories.description: Integrate Stripe payment gateway for credit card payments
acceptance_criteria: The system successfully processes a credit card payment and updates the order status
The system handles declined credit card payments and displays an error message to the user

tasks.title: Setup Stripe payment gateway API
tasks.description: Create a Stripe account, generate API keys, and configure the payment gateway

tasks.title: Implement credit card payment form and processing
tasks.description: Create a secure payment form, handle user input, and process credit card payments using Stripe API

tasks.title: Test and validate credit card payment functionality
tasks.description: Test credit card payment processing, handle errors, and validate payment success

stories.title: As a customer, I want to manage my subscriptions, so that I can update or cancel my recurring payments
acceptance_criteria: The system allows users to update their subscription plans and billing information
The system cancels subscriptions and stops recurring payments when requested by the user

tasks.title: Implement subscription plan management using Stripe API
tasks.description: Create, update, and delete subscription plans using Stripe API

tasks.title: Develop subscription management UI and user workflow
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for subscription management and handle user input

tasks.title: Test and validate subscription management functionality
tasks.description: Test subscription plan updates, cancellations, and billing information changes

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to receive payment event notifications, so that I can track and manage payment-related activities
stories.description: Implement webhook handling for payment events and email notifications
acceptance_criteria: The system receives and processes payment event webhooks from Stripe
The system sends email notifications to administrators for successful payments and payment-related events

tasks.title: Setup Stripe webhook endpoint and configure event handling
tasks.description: Create a webhook endpoint, configure event handling, and test Stripe webhook notifications

tasks.title: Develop email notification system for payment events
tasks.description: Create email templates, handle email sending, and test email notifications

tasks.title: Test and validate payment event handling and email notifications
tasks.description: Test payment event handling, email notifications, and validate system behavior

epics.title: User Authentication System
epics.description: A comprehensive system for user authentication, including login, signup, password reset, and OAuth integration

stories.title: As a user, I want to login to the system using email and password, so that I can access my account securely
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using their email and password, and authenticate them securely
acceptance_criteria: The system authenticates users correctly with valid email and password
The system displays an error message when the user enters an invalid email or password
The system redirects the user to their dashboard after successful login

tasks.title: Implement email and password authentication logic
tasks.description: Write the backend code to handle email and password authentication

tasks.title: Create a login page with email and password fields
tasks.description: Design and implement the frontend login page with email and password fields

tasks.title: Test the login functionality with different scenarios
tasks.description: Write unit tests and integration tests to cover different login scenarios

stories.title: As a new user, I want to signup for an account, so that I can use the system's features
stories.description: The system should allow new users to signup for an account, and send a verification email to their email address
acceptance_criteria: The system creates a new user account with the provided information
The system sends a verification email to the user's email address
The system displays a success message after the user signs up

tasks.title: Implement the user signup logic
tasks.description: Write the backend code to handle user signup and send a verification email

tasks.title: Create a signup page with required fields
tasks.description: Design and implement the frontend signup page with required fields

tasks.title: Test the signup functionality with different scenarios
tasks.description: Write unit tests and integration tests to cover different signup scenarios

stories.title: As a user, I want to reset my password, so that I can recover my account
stories.description: The system should allow users to reset their password, and send a password reset link to their email address
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a password reset link to the user's email address
The system allows the user to reset their password using the password reset link
The system displays a success message after the user resets their password

tasks.title: Implement the password reset logic
tasks.description: Write the backend code to handle password reset and send a password reset link

tasks.title: Create a password reset page with required fields
tasks.description: Design and implement the frontend password reset page with required fields

tasks.title: Test the password reset functionality with different scenarios
tasks.description: Write unit tests and integration tests to cover different password reset scenarios

stories.title: As a user, I want to login using OAuth with Google and GitHub, so that I can use my existing accounts to access the system
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using OAuth with Google and GitHub, and authenticate them securely
acceptance_criteria: The system authenticates users correctly using OAuth with Google
The system authenticates users correctly using OAuth with GitHub
The system redirects the user to their dashboard after successful OAuth login

tasks.title: Implement OAuth integration with Google
tasks.description: Write the backend code to handle OAuth authentication with Google

tasks.title: Implement OAuth integration with GitHub
tasks.description: Write the backend code to handle OAuth authentication with GitHub

tasks.title: Test the OAuth login functionality with different scenarios
tasks.description: Write unit tests and integration tests to cover different OAuth login scenarios

epics.title: Email Notification System
epics.description: A system for sending transactional emails to users for important events

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive a welcome email when I sign up, so that I feel engaged and informed about the platform
stories.description: The system should send a welcome email to new users with a personalized message and useful links to get started
acceptance_criteria: The welcome email is sent to the user's registered email address within 1 minute of signing up
The welcome email contains the user's name and a link to the platform's getting started guide
The welcome email is sent successfully even if the user has a non-standard email address

tasks.title: Implement email template for welcome email
tasks.description: Design and implement a reusable email template for the welcome email

tasks.title: Integrate with SendGrid for welcome email delivery
tasks.description: Set up and configure SendGrid to send the welcome email to new users

tasks.title: Test welcome email functionality with different email addresses
tasks.description: Test the welcome email functionality with various email addresses to ensure compatibility

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive a password reset link via email, so that I can recover my account if I forget my password
stories.description: The system should send a password reset link to the user's registered email address when they request a password reset
acceptance_criteria: The password reset link is sent to the user's registered email address within 1 minute of requesting a password reset
The password reset link is valid for at least 30 minutes and can be used to reset the password successfully
The password reset link is sent successfully even if the user has a non-standard email address

tasks.title: Implement password reset link generation and email sending
tasks.description: Generate a password reset link and send it to the user's registered email address

tasks.title: Integrate with AWS SES for password reset email delivery
tasks.description: Set up and configure AWS SES to send the password reset email to users

tasks.title: Test password reset link functionality with different email addresses
tasks.description: Test the password reset link functionality with various email addresses to ensure compatibility

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive payment receipts via email, so that I have a record of my transactions
stories.description: The system should send a payment receipt to the user's registered email address after a successful payment
acceptance_criteria: The payment receipt is sent to the user's registered email address within 1 minute of a successful payment
The payment receipt contains the payment amount, date, and a unique transaction ID
The payment receipt is sent successfully even if the user has a non-standard email address

tasks.title: Implement payment receipt email template
tasks.description: Design and implement a reusable email template for the payment receipt

tasks.title: Integrate with payment gateway to trigger payment receipt email
tasks.description: Set up and configure the payment gateway to trigger the payment receipt email after a successful payment

tasks.title: Test payment receipt email functionality with different payment methods
tasks.description: Test the payment receipt email functionality with various payment methods to ensure compatibility

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive account notifications via email, so that I stay informed about important events
stories.description: The system should send account notifications to the user's registered email address for important events such as account updates or security alerts
acceptance_criteria: The account notification is sent to the user's registered email address within 1 minute of an important event
The account notification contains a clear and concise message about the event
The account notification is sent successfully even if the user has a non-standard email address

tasks.title: Implement account notification email template
tasks.description: Design and implement a reusable email template for the account notification

tasks.title: Integrate with account management system to trigger account notification email
tasks.description: Set up and configure the account management system to trigger the account notification email for important events

tasks.title: Test account notification email functionality with different event types
tasks.description: Test the account notification email functionality with various event types to ensure compatibility

epics.title: Admin Dashboard
epics.description: A dashboard for internal team to manage users, monitor the platform, and view analytics

stories.title: As an administrator, I want to manage users, so that I can control access to the platform
stories.description: The administrator should be able to create, edit, and delete user accounts, as well as assign roles and permissions
acceptance_criteria: The system allows administrators to create new user accounts with unique usernames and passwords
The system allows administrators to edit existing user accounts, including roles and permissions
The system allows administrators to delete user accounts and prevent further access
The system prevents administrators from creating duplicate user accounts

tasks.title: Design and implement user account creation functionality
tasks.description: Create a user interface for creating new user accounts, including validation for unique usernames and passwords

tasks.title: Implement user account editing functionality
tasks.description: Create a user interface for editing existing user accounts, including roles and permissions

tasks.title: Implement user account deletion functionality and testing
tasks.description: Create a user interface for deleting user accounts and prevent further access, including testing for duplicate account prevention

stories.title: As an administrator, I want to view analytics dashboards, so that I can monitor platform performance
stories.description: The administrator should be able to view key metrics and analytics, including active users, revenue, and system performance
acceptance_criteria: The system displays the number of active users on the platform
The system displays revenue metrics, including total revenue and revenue growth
The system displays system performance metrics, including response times and error rates
The system updates analytics dashboards in real-time

tasks.title: Design and implement analytics dashboard user interface
tasks.description: Create a user interface for displaying key metrics and analytics

tasks.title: Implement data collection and processing for analytics dashboards
tasks.description: Collect and process data for key metrics and analytics, including active users, revenue, and system performance

tasks.title: Implement real-time updates for analytics dashboards
tasks.description: Update analytics dashboards in real-time, including testing for data accuracy and consistency

stories.title: As an administrator, I want to monitor system health, so that I can identify and resolve issues
stories.description: The administrator should be able to view system health metrics, including error logs and system performance
acceptance_criteria: The system displays system health metrics, including error rates and response times
The system displays error logs, including error messages and timestamps
The system alerts administrators to critical system health issues
The system provides filtering and sorting options for error logs

tasks.title: Design and implement system health monitoring user interface
tasks.description: Create a user interface for displaying system health metrics and error logs

tasks.title: Implement data collection and processing for system health metrics
tasks.description: Collect and process data for system health metrics, including error rates and response times

tasks.title: Implement alerting and filtering functionality for system health issues
tasks.description: Alert administrators to critical system health issues and provide filtering and sorting options for error logs

stories.title: As an administrator, I want to manage configuration, so that I can customize the platform
stories.description: The administrator should be able to manage configuration settings, including user interface customization and feature toggles
acceptance_criteria: The system allows administrators to customize the user interface, including colors and layouts
The system allows administrators to toggle features on and off
The system saves and applies configuration settings correctly
The system prevents administrators from saving invalid configuration settings

tasks.title: Design and implement configuration management user interface
tasks.description: Create a user interface for managing configuration settings, including user interface customization and feature toggles

tasks.title: Implement configuration setting storage and retrieval
tasks.description: Store and retrieve configuration settings, including testing for data consistency and accuracy

tasks.title: Implement validation and error handling for configuration settings
tasks.description: Validate configuration settings and handle errors, including testing for invalid settings

stories.title: As an administrator, I want to view real-time metrics, so that I can monitor platform activity
stories.description: The administrator should be able to view real-time metrics, including active users, revenue, and system performance
acceptance_criteria: The system displays real-time metrics, including active users and revenue
The system updates real-time metrics every minute
The system displays historical data for real-time metrics
The system provides filtering and sorting options for real-time metrics

tasks.title: Design and implement real-time metrics user interface
tasks.description: Create a user interface for displaying real-time metrics, including active users and revenue

tasks.title: Implement data collection and processing for real-time metrics
tasks.description: Collect and process data for real-time metrics, including testing for data accuracy and consistency

tasks.title: Implement filtering and sorting functionality for real-time metrics
tasks.description: Provide filtering and sorting options for real-time metrics, including testing for data consistency and accuracy
